title: Phrasal Verbs
note: Hand-maintained; not generated from any other file. Core verbs stand alone; lower-frequency verbs are amalgamated into MIX sets so every set is worth a round and the whole course fits one row of tabs. Items in a MIX carry their own `verb`; `form` holds the inflected verb an example sentence needs. Renderers must use form || verb || group.id. Options are the correct particle plus three others used with the SAME verb.
